title: Ever Cancelled
statement: Return the `name` of every customer who has cancelled **at least one** order, each name once, in any order.
reference: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled')
wrong: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled')
